description: React component for exploring a mind map of roles, including fetching recommendations, filtering, and rendering a visual graph with details panel.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes input to a trimmed string, handling unknown types.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts input to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from a role object, checking multiple possible fields.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title string from a role object.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between a minimum and maximum value.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Normalizes salary range into UI slider units (USD thousands), handling different formats and currencies.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role matches selected industry, skills, and salary range filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches role recommendations based on persona ID and optional mode/pathType.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts stored view state to viewport object with clamped zoom.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport and selected node ID into view state object for storage.
